scenarios.label: Checkerboard
scenarios.description: Two interleaved square grids with regular overlap.

scenarios.label: Not overlap
scenarios.description: Two interleaved grids whose squares never intersect.

scenarios.label: Lines net
scenarios.description: A dense grid formed by intersecting horizontal and vertical bars.

scenarios.label: Orthogonal wind mill
scenarios.description: A repeated four-fold pinwheel made only from orthogonal blades.

scenarios.label: Cross
scenarios.description: Two overlapping rectangles with square holes near four arm ends and at the center.

scenarios.label: Tetris square
scenarios.description: Four diagonally paired L tetrominoes form a square frame around a 3x3-cell hole.

scenarios.label: Windows
scenarios.description: A grid of square frames, each producing one hole.

scenarios.label: Nested squares
scenarios.description: Union of concentric square rails with deep shape nesting.

scenarios.label: Sieve
scenarios.description: One large square perforated by a regular grid of square holes.
